metaTitle: OrganiPhos Organic Phosphorus | OMRI | Terra Preta | Prairie Soils
metaDescription: OrganiPhos — OMRI-listed organic phosphorus with a multi-phase release profile for prairie grain crops. 14% P₂O₅, 18% Ca. Seed-placed or side-band. Quote from Sundre, AB.
heroSubtitle: Organic phosphorus fertility for establishment, rooting, and yield response where phosphate from approved organic sources is required.
tagline: Three-phase phosphorus release for prairie grain crops—designed for alkaline soils where P ties up, OMRI listed, from Sundre, Alberta.
conversionBullets: Analysis 1-14-0.6 + 18% Ca (see product label for guarantees)
Multi-phase P release from germination through grain fill
Fishbone, bone ash & mineral P sources — biologically activated
Seed-placed, side-band, or fall broadcast programs
omriCallout: OrganiPhos is OMRI Listed® for organic crop production, so certifiers and growers can confirm organic eligibility without opening a spec sheet. Permitted uses and any crop or rate limits are on the product label; we can provide the OMRI listing reference for your certifier on request.
descriptionParagraphs: OrganiPhos delivers phosphorus in forms compatible with organic cropping systems, supporting early growth, rooting, and reproductive development.
Pair with soil testing and your agronomist's recommendations. We support row crops, forage, horticulture, and specialty markets.

keySpecs.label: Guaranteed analysis
keySpecs.value: 1-14-0.6 + 18% Ca — confirm current label; includes 14% P₂O₅ and sulfate sulfur as listed.

keySpecs.label: Phosphorus strategy
keySpecs.value: Multiple P sources for a staged release profile from germination through grain fill; BSFL frass supports phosphorus-solubilizing biology.

keySpecs.label: Prairie soils
keySpecs.value: Formulated with alkaline prairie phosphorus fixation in mind.

keySpecs.label: Application modes
keySpecs.value: Typical programs: seed-placed (~35 lb/ac), side-band (~70 lb/ac), fall broadcast up to ~200 lb/ac — final rates from soil test and agronomy.

keySpecs.label: OMRI
keySpecs.value: OMRI Listed® for certified organic production (see label for listing scope).

keySpecs.label: Crops
keySpecs.value: Canola, wheat, lentils, chickpeas, peas, and other organic rotations.

keySpecs.label: Origin & service area
keySpecs.value: Made in Sundre, Alberta. Programs for Alberta, Saskatchewan, and beyond.
